heroHeadline: CDC and FDA Track Largest-Ever U.S. Cyclosporiasis Outbreak: 27,557 Combined Cases, 2 Dead
heroSubtitle: A multistate outbreak traced to Taylor Farms de México iceberg lettuce served at Taco Bell and sold under Walmart's Marketside brand has sickened 27,557 people across 47 states, DC, and Puerto Rico since May 1, prompting a nationwide recall, and now a Senate letter to HHS Secretary RFK Jr. over the administration's handling of the response.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
